name: Unified Intelligence Version 2.0 Paper Dataset

paper.title: Measuring the Unified Intelligence Level: A Cumulative, Harness-Measurable Hierarchy

coordinate_dataset_dependency.name: HIL Coordinate Benchmark Datasets
coordinate_dataset_dependency.framework_basis: Unified Intelligence / HIL v1.9, carried forward by Version 2.0

evidence_scope: Paper-supporting benchmark and measurement data; not a universal model ranking or a complete certification record.
known_limitations: The coordinate dependency has no runnable certification evidence for C5 and above.
The HSC release reconstructs episode telemetry from a canonical aggregate log and local transcripts; complete raw workspaces, acceptance records and termination reasons were not archived.
The HSC run contains 53 harness-loop iterations but 52 model calls because one HG2 iteration selected a criteria-only provider before model launch.
The archived frontier regime-switch CSV does not identify the frontier model or executor version.
Six frontier regime-switch rows lack wall time and target-spread values.
The regime-switch study has one attempt per executor per seed, one mechanism family, one host/harness configuration and no repeat-run variance estimate.
Neither original regime-switch CSV contains a separate termination-reason field.
